latest_release.name: v10.6.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(locale): exclude forbidden letter combinations from nl postcodes by @chatman-media in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3888
* feat(locale): add Norwegian (nb_NO) animal module by @arvindfroi in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3901
* feat(locale): add Norwegian (nb_NO) food module by @arvindfroi in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3900
* fix(locale): only generate valid French postal codes by @MahinAnowar in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3905
* feat(phone): mobile styles for more locales by @matthewmayer in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3902
* docs: add Deno to install instructions by @bartlomieju in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3907
* refactor(locale): normalize phone_number data by @xDivisionByZerox in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3518
* chore(deps): update devdependencies by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3909
* chore(deps): update vitest to v4.1.9 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3910
* chore(deps): update actions/checkout action to v7 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3913
* chore(deps): update all non-major dependencies by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3911
* chore(deps): update eslint by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3912
* chore(deps): update mcr.microsoft.com/devcontainers/typescript-node:24 docker digest to 0cbad76 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3908
* infra: ignore tmp folder by @Shinigami92 in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3915
* chore(deps): lock file maintenance by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3903
* chore: fix typo in helper module by @hiSandog in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3918
* docs(science): fix typo in Unit.symbol by @hiSandog in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3917
* fix: groupBy handling for prototype property keys by @hiSandog in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3906
* refactor(locale): add en_NP and change ne to Devangari by @matthewmayer in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3868
* chore(deps): update eslint (major) by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3914
* chore: move modules to dedicated files by @Shinigami92 in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3890
* docs: merge iata hint into jsdocs by @ST-DDT in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3920
* test(science): make definition lookups actually assert by @hiSandog in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3919
* feat: introduce NumberRange type by @Shinigami92 in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3838
* chore: consistent type import paths by @ST-DDT in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3926
* feat(locale): add 060 Japanese mobile phone number formats by @noritaka1166 in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3922
* feat(locale): better organize first_name by gender for en by @matthewmayer in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3924
* chore: adjust generate:locales to directly import from definitions by @ST-DDT in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3927
* chore: fix last remaining import path by @ST-DDT in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3934
* feat(locale): better middle names by gender for en locale by @matthewmayer in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3932
* docs(datatype): drop the two-decimal-places note from boolean() by @spokodev in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3935
* refactor(location): distinguish between street_name_part and street_name by @ST-DDT in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3859
* fix(locale): use only common surnames for zh_CN last names by @MahinAnowar in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3938
* docs: remove incorrect part from string.sample jsdocs by @ST-DDT in https://github.com/faker-js/faker/pull/3941
* fix(internet): validate CIDR prefix length and octet range in ipv4() by @hiSandog in https://github.com/faker-js/
